messages:
sam: Quick plan for tonight 23:45 UTC - micro-cutover for router-api. Goal: flip routing_v2 flag for a tiny traffic slice to validate cache/replica routing. Steps: pin canary to rc4, enable flag at 0.05% -> 0.5% -> 5% with 12m between bumps. Need SRE + product watch.

deploy-bot: Proposed window: start=2026-03-21T23:45Z; actions=[pin:router-api@rc4, ff:set routing_v2 cohorts=[0.05%,0.5%,5%] intervals=[12m,12m] auto_dampen=true rollback_cmd=/ff set routing_v2=off]

tanya: I'm available. Please include ap-south as an excluded cohort for the first bump (regional infra noisy overnight). Also run session-proxy canary first.

sre-oncall: Add preflight hooks: session-proxy-check, cache-prime, /slo-check --window=10m --budget=3%. If p95 > 250ms for 5m OR 5xx_rate > 0.4% for 8m, hold and soft-disable.

sam: config I'm going to apply (posting for visibility):

```json
{ "pin": "router-api@rc4", "flag": "routing_v2", "cohorts": ["0.05%","0.5%","5%"], "intervals": ["12m","12m"], "exclude_regions": ["ap-south"], "preflight": ["session-proxy-check","cache-prime"], "auto_dampen": true, "rollback_cmd": "/ff set routing_v2=off" }
```

lee: small ask: surface kv-cache miss rate and replica-redirects in the dashboard for the canary cohort. If replica-redirects > 1% we stop.

product-ops: support notified, product ok as long as we have the soft-disable key. Also leave pin for 90m post-ramp.

deploy-bot: preflight: session-proxy-check=OK, cache-prime=OK, loadgen=smoke pass, deps=OK. Ready to go.

sam: kicking off in 3.

deploy-bot: pin applied. routing_v2 -> 0.05% applied. logs: "pin: router-api@rc4" 

tanya: seeing initial hits in primary regions only, ap-south excluded. kv-miss=0.6% for canary, replica-redirect=0.2%. all good so far.

deploy-bot: bump: 0.05% -> 0.5% at ts=7261240030. next check in 12m.

sre-oncall: noticing a small p95 blip in eu-central: p95 up to 320ms for ~3m, p99 stable. holding a manual observation for 4m. If p95 persists beyond 5m we'll trigger soft-disable.

sam: let's hold the next bump until we confirm the p95 settles. canceling scheduled bump.

deploy-bot: scheduled bump canceled. routing_v2 remains at 0.5%.

lee: after tracing, cause looks like a transient KV leader election in eu-central. mitigation: increase cache TTL for canary cohort and re-prime.

sam: running cache-prime --targets=canary-eu; will re-evaluate in 6m.

deploy-bot: cache-prime completed. kv-miss dropped to 0.15%, p95 back to 190ms.

sre-oncall: all gates green. recommend proceed to 5% but exclude ap-south still. Ensure rollback_cmd is on standby.

product-ops: thumbs up. leaving pin for 90m after reaching 5%.

deploy-bot: final bump to 5% initiated. logs: "ramp: reached 5%" ts=7261240060

lee: metrics stable: p50=32ms p95=188ms p99=420ms error_rate=0.06% kv-miss=0.12% replica-redirect=0.1%

sam: nice. leaving pin. follow-up: we'll run a slow-roll to full after 2h if telemetry stays steady. I'll open a post-rollout note in the release doc.

product-ops: thanks everyone. Will coordinate post-rollout comms and release notes.
